title: AttemptRecord
description: One execution attempt on one Atom, at artifacts/atoms/<atom_id>/attempts/<attempt_id>.json. docs/implementation/agent-runbook.md section 7 requires the record on every verifier_failed, timed_out, budget_exceeded, abandoned, and contract_defect outcome, and says it is validated in CI by the same validator as the closure record: scripts/check-closure-records.sh validates both. An attempt is not a specification: a failed attempt never mutates the Atom contract (AGENTS.md), which is why a contract_defect outcome must name the new issue it opened instead.

attempt_id.description: <started_at as a compact UTC timestamp>-<harness>, for example 20260830T142530Z-claude-code. The file name MUST be <attempt_id>.json, so an attempt cannot be silently overwritten and attempts sort chronologically; scripts/check-closure-records.sh enforces both.

atom_id.description: bootstrap: the GitHub issue number as a string; MUST equal the containing artifacts/atoms/<atom_id>/ directory

spec_digest.description: the spec revision this attempt was made against, defined exactly as in closure-record.schema.json: SHA-256, lowercase hex, of artifacts/atoms/<atom_id>/spec.md after LF normalization

actor.description: the actor that made the attempt (docs/implementation/agent-runbook.md section 6.1, G-511)

outcome.description: the closed set of docs/implementation/agent-runbook.md section 7. A closed set, not free text: an outcome nobody can spell is an outcome nobody can count.

reason.description: why this attempt ended with that outcome, in one sentence. Never empty: 'retain failed, timed-out, excluded, and negative runs with reasons' (AGENTS.md).

contract_defect_issue.description: the issue opened against the Atom's contract. REQUIRED when outcome is contract_defect, and forbidden otherwise; scripts/check-closure-records.sh enforces both directions, so 'the contract is wrong' cannot be asserted without a repair Atom to answer it.

exact_state_id.description: the state the attempt ended on, when one was frozen; absent when the attempt never reached a candidate

verifiers.description: the verifier runs this attempt performed, in the shape closure-record.schema.json uses. A verifier_failed attempt SHOULD carry the failing run.

budget.description: observed spend against the section 7 caps: 4 hours wall clock and USD 25 per Atom
